description: This file contains unit tests for the WakeWordGate functionality in the SwabbleKit project. It verifies the matching logic for wake word detection, including trigger requirements, command extraction, multi-word triggers, and handling of range indices within transcript processing.

classes.name: WakeWordGateTests
classes.description: A test suite for validating WakeWordGate behavior, including trigger matching, command extraction, and edge case handling.

methods.name: matchRequiresGapAfterTrigger
methods.description: Tests that the WakeWordGate match function returns nil if the minimum post-trigger gap is not satisfied.

methods.name: matchAllowsGapAndExtractsCommand
methods.description: Tests that a valid wake word trigger correctly extracts the subsequent command when the gap condition is met.

methods.name: matchHandlesMultiWordTriggers
methods.description: Verifies that multi-word trigger phrases are correctly handled and matched.

methods.name: commandTextHandlesForeignRangeIndices
methods.description: Ensures that command text extraction correctly handles range indices that originate from outside the transcript's range, maintaining accurate command parsing.
